resources.description: ElevenLabs text-to-speech: send text (up to 4000 chars) with optional voice_id, model, format, and speed; get back a hosted audio_url plus size and content type. Send 'Accept: audio/mpeg' to stream raw audio bytes directly instead. Voice catalog with free preview clips at GET /voices (no payment). Priced per character; the 402 amount is computed from your text length.
